title: Windows tool-chain traps: PowerShell 5.1 BOM and quoting, ffmpeg drawtext, ERR_ABORTED
summary: PS 5.1 writes UTF-8 with a BOM, strips inner quotes of native args and breaks ${} in replaces; ffmpeg drawtext fails (fontconfig); headless REQFAIL ERR_ABORTED is harmless.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: [IO.File]::WriteAllText(path, text, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))   # no BOM; pass a camera as 'p|l|fov' not JSON

doc.when: Scripting renders, patches and project files on Windows.
doc.avoid: Set-Content -Encoding utf8 for JSON; patching code with PowerShell string replace when it contains backticks or ${.
gotchas: Use the Edit tool for code edits.
Print failure().errorText and ignore ERR_ABORTED (duplicate in-flight glb requests).

problem.symptom: JSON with a BOM, mangled command-line args, broken patches, failing drawtext, scary REQFAIL lines.
problem.cause: PowerShell 5.1 defaults and quoting rules; no fontconfig for ffmpeg drawtext here; Chromium aborting duplicate requests.
problem.fix: BOM-less writes, '|'-separated args, the Edit tool, no drawtext (draw labels in the page), ignore ERR_ABORTED.
problem.detect: First bytes EF BB BF; args missing quotes; REQFAIL with net::ERR_ABORTED.
